description: TypeScript type definitions for the 'ical.js' library, including classes and methods for handling iCalendar data such as events, components, timezones, recurrence, and parsing.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: Represents an iCalendar component with methods to manipulate properties and subcomponents.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents an iCalendar event with properties like uid, summary, start/end times, and recurrence handling.

classes.name: Property
classes.description: Represents a property within an iCalendar component, with methods to get/set values and parameters.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: Represents a date/time object with methods for comparison, conversion, and adjustment.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: Represents a duration of time with methods to convert to seconds.

classes.name: Timezone
classes.description: Represents a timezone with conversion capabilities.

classes.name: RecurData
classes.description: Data structure for recurrence rule parameters.

classes.name: Recur
classes.description: Defines recurrence rules with methods for cloning and JSON serialization.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Function to parse iCalendar data from a string input.
